appName.message: SafeTabs – Save Tabs, Never Lose Them

appDesc.message: Save all your tabs in one click and free up memory. Auto-backups, 30-day trash and OneTab import, so your saved tabs never disappear.

cmdSave.message: Save all tabs in this window

saveWindow.message: Save all tabs in this window

empty.message: No saved tabs yet. Click the SafeTabs icon and choose “Save all tabs in this window”.

trashNote.message: Deleted groups stay here for 30 days.

backupsNote.message: A copy is kept automatically before every change (latest 10).

recoveryNote.message: Your open tabs are copied every 5 minutes. If the browser closed unexpectedly, you can save them from here.

importNote.message: Works with SafeTabs JSON and OneTab exports (lines of “URL | title”). Paste text below or choose a file.

importFail.message: Could not read this. Please check the file.

dedupe.message: Skip duplicate pages in one save

deleted.message: Deleted. You can put it back from Trash.

confirmBackup.message: Replace your saved tabs with this backup? (Your current list is backed up first.)

privacy.message: Your tabs are stored only in this browser. Nothing is sent to any server.
